title: MUVNA Tivat
description: Every cup in the TIVAT collection by MUVNA is more than a vessel for your drink. It is a small work of art that turns every drink into a ritual full of light, color and inspiration. It is made for those who seek beauty, comfort and impeccable quality in everyday life, and who know that even the simplest moment can become special when surrounded by beautiful details.

The cup is made from high-quality tempered glass that combines crystal clarity with exceptional strength. Unlike ordinary glass, it withstands temperature changes, staying intact whether it holds a hot espresso or a refreshing iced latte. The material is also completely safe: it contains no lead, cadmium or other heavy metals, reflecting the brand's commitment to tableware you can trust every day.

The cup's design deserves special mention. Its surface is adorned with elegant three-dimensional vertical ribs that not only give it a distinctive style and musical rhythm, but also serve a practical purpose, providing reliable heat insulation and an anti-slip grip that makes every touch comfortable and secure. A thin metallic coating applied by vacuum deposition gives the glass a refined shimmering hue, increases its wear resistance and protects it from scratches, keeping it looking flawless for years.

The wide mouth with a smoothly rounded, carefully polished rim feels pleasant to the touch and opens up endless creative possibilities: it is comfortable to drink from and ideal for latte art, letting you control the flow of milk foam with jewel-like precision. The cup comes in a rich palette of colors, from classic to vivid rainbow hues, so you can choose the perfect accent for your coffee station and make it truly your own.

Please note that minor production marks such as tiny bubbles, black specks, faint scratches or water marks may occur in this glassware. These are not defects and do not affect functionality or appearance; they simply highlight the handcrafted nature of the piece. TIVAT is more than a cup. It is an invitation to pause, take a sip and savor the moment, where every detail works for your enjoyment.

title: MUVNA Tasting Cups
description: This MUVNA aroma cup is made for those who see coffee not just as a drink, but as a complete sensory experience where aroma, taste and touch merge into a single harmony. Every line and every curve serves one purpose: to awaken the coffee's aromatic bouquet and let it unfold in all its fullness, from the first drop to the last sip.

Made from high-quality kaolin and fired at 1300 degrees, the cup gains a refined matte texture that is not only delicate and elegant to the eye but also pleasant in the hand, enhancing the perception of the drink's flavor and sweetness. Ceramic fired at such high temperatures becomes incredibly strong, heat-resistant and durable, keeping its flawless look for years.

The cup's thoughtful shape deserves special mention. Its flared rim, 63 millimeters in diameter, significantly increases the contact area between the coffee and the palate, allowing aroma and flavor to unfold in a richer, more layered way, while the smooth, rounded lip follows the natural shape of the lips, making every sip remarkably comfortable and full. The hemispherical bottom, in turn, improves the flow of the drink, ensuring an even distribution of flavor notes and creating a sense of wholeness and harmony in the cup.

The absence of a handle gives the cup a modern, minimalist look, emphasizing its clean aesthetic and focusing on the tactile contact with the ceramic. The cup invites you to wrap your hands around it, feel its warmth and focus on the moment. The unglazed base provides stability and a secure grip on the surface, preventing slipping and protecting your table from scratches, making the cup equally suited to home use and professional coffee shops.

Available in several elegant gradient colorways, from soft pink to smoky blue, this cup not only does its main job but also becomes a stylish accent on your coffee station, adding vivid color and personality. It is the perfect choice for espresso and pour-over lovers who understand that the right cup can turn a simple morning into a small ritual full of aroma, warmth and inspiration.

title: MUVNA Kare latte cup
description: This MUVNA cup and saucer set is more than just a cup and saucer. It is an elegant addition to your coffee ritual, created for those who value harmony of form, tactile comfort and visual beauty in everyday life. Every detail is designed to make enjoying your drink truly complete and pleasurable.

The cup's ergonomic curved handle seems made to rest naturally and comfortably in your hand, following its curve and providing a secure, comfortable grip even during extended use. Thanks to thoughtful heat insulation, the handle stays pleasantly warm but never too hot, letting you enjoy your drink at your own pace. Stability comes from the unglazed base, which fits precisely into the saucer's recess, preventing slipping and accidental tipping while giving the setting a finished, considered look.

The Kare cup and saucer set is made from high-quality ceramic with a smooth colored glaze, pleasing both the eye and the hand: the surface of the cup is soft and pleasant to the touch, while the classic shape highlights its refinement and versatility. The decorative pattern is applied using high-temperature decals, staying crisp and vibrant even after many wash cycles, never fading or peeling and keeping its elegant look for years.

The set is available in six refined colorways: from warm sunset orange and soft creamy white to deep mustard yellow, classic gray, fresh sky blue and pure ivory. This variety makes it easy to fit the cups into any interior, from a minimalist kitchen to a cozy coffee shop or stylish office, and to mix and match them for a personalized table setting to suit any taste. The 280 ml capacity is ideal for most popular drinks, making this set a perfect choice for everyday use as well as a gift for loved ones who appreciate coffee and beauty.

title: MUVNA Latte Cup
description: The MUVNA latte art cup and saucer set is more than tableware. It is your everyday companion in the world of coffee, created for those who value harmony of form, comfort and impeccable taste in every detail. Its understated yet expressive design is inspired by the idea of simplicity that becomes timeless, and every element, from the flowing lines to the matte surface, speaks to careful attention to aesthetics and touch.

The cup is made from high-quality food-grade ceramic that contains no lead, cadmium or other harmful impurities, making it completely safe and suitable for both hot and cold drinks. The material is heat-resistant, withstands sudden temperature changes and does not deform over time, while the smooth, dense ceramic is easy to clean and keeps its flawless look even after many wash cycles.

The cup's thoughtful ergonomics deserve special mention. Its rim is thickened to 6 millimeters, not merely as a design statement but as a deliberate choice that shapes the lip of the cup perfectly for the mouth, giving a pleasant, comfortable feel with every sip. The matte surface not only adds a refined restraint but also provides a secure, non-slip grip, and the body follows the natural curve of the palm so the cup rests comfortably in your hand without strain. The handle is shaped around the natural position of the fingers, making every sip truly relaxing.

The saucer is made from the same high-quality ceramic and pairs perfectly with the cup: the cup's rounded base and the saucer's special recess ensure a stable, non-slip fit, preventing accidental shifting and spills. This is especially important when serving, where every detail needs to be in its place.

The pattern and lettering on the cup are applied with eco-friendly high-temperature inks that are fired at high temperatures. As a result, the decoration stays bright and durable for a long time, without fading or wearing off even with frequent dishwasher use.

The set is available in two classic sizes, 220 and 280 ml, making it a versatile choice for a wide range of drinks: from a delicate cappuccino and velvety latte to a bold americano, aromatic hot chocolate, mochaccino or tea. It makes a perfect gift for any coffee enthusiast or a great addition to your own collection, adding a touch of refinement to every day. With MUVNA, every morning begins with a small ritual where even the cup speaks of a love for coffee.
